children.value: > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried allegedly stole customer funds to facilitate his jet-setting lifestyle, donate millions to political candidates, and finance risky bets.
> > > Fact From Story: The prosecution’s account of the alleged crimes by Bankman-Fried featured a study in contrasts.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Stealing money is wrong.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: People who commit fraud are often charged with crimes.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud and conspiracy are crimes.
